welcome.title: Pokes
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! You can take off the headset.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Pokes
sections.intro: Windows close in front of you, within arm's reach. Point your index finger and poke the lit button, as on a touch screen: the fingertip in to the window's surface, then back out. Nothing happens when you poke: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand: point your index finger and poke each button as it lights, in and back out.|Start with the other fingers tucked in.

switch.to: a relaxed hand, the other fingers loosely curled

prompts.text: Left hand: point your index finger and poke each button as it lights.|Start with a relaxed hand, the other fingers loosely curled.
A low window, near your lap, as if on a desk: poke its buttons with your right hand,|reaching down to it.
One window high, one out to your right. Poke the lit button with your right hand,|keeping your head facing ahead.
Both hands up, index fingers pointing. Each lit button says L or R:|poke it with that hand.
Right hand. A button showing hold: poke it and keep the fingertip on it until it goes out.|One showing slide: poke it and slide the fingertip down, as if scrolling a page.
Left hand. Quick pokes, and holds: keep the fingertip on the button until it goes out.
Small buttons: poke the lit one with your right hand, as exactly as you can.
Right hand. Cyan: poke it. Orange with a cross: bring the fingertip about 1 cm short of it|and stop there, without touching.
Your own pace: poke the lit button as often as you like.|Move while you do: the arm bent and straight, the hand higher and lower.

says.poke: Your own pace: poke it as often as you like
